scope: 685 finite reference cases; these do not establish global error bounds, historical clock accuracy, or correctness of house cusps.

conventions.frame: tropical longitude of date, true equator/equinox, IAU2006/2000A
conventions.time: ISO clock digits treated as UT1; TT=UT1+69s; UTC minus UT1 set to zero by design, not an Earth-orientation prediction
conventions.latitude: north-positive astronomical horizon latitude; same numerical value as supplied engine latitude, no deflection-of-vertical correction
conventions.asc: rising intersection of geometric horizon and ecliptic; at high latitude this may differ by 180 degrees from another software convention
conventions.mc: ecliptic intersection on upper local meridian; no requirement to lie above the horizon
